title: Tigerbay private deploy — sync notes & actions
content:
Purpose: quick mid-week sync to confirm milestone progress, unblock networking and storage, and align owners for next two sprints. Tone: working notes — rough, action-focused.

High-level context:
- Customer: Tigerbay (ad revenue analytics) — strict egress controls, HSM for keys, needs air-gapped option during PII ingest windows.
- Scope for this phase: VPC peering + managed VPN, on-prem VM prep for inference nodes, KMS integration test, smoke tests for latency under 600ms p95.
- Current sprint: infra provisioning + first-pass KV cache tuning.

Quick status bullets (as of sync):
- VPC subnet allocation: done in staging account, awaiting CIDR approval for prod (Alexei to confirm).
- VPN tunnel: established but intermittent rekeying (seen 2 drops last 24h).
- On-prem VM prep: Tigerbay storage team confirmed NFS mounts but SELinux/profile mismatch on initial node.
- KMS/HSM: test key provisioned; access logs show denied calls for service account redwood-deploy-sa (likely IAM role mapping bug).
- Model artifacts: model v1.3 uploaded to internal registry, quantized artifact built but size mismatch vs spec (possible padding bug).
- Observability hooks: tracing enabled, but sampling set too low to observe tail-latency spikes.

Blockers (root-cause hypotheses):
1) VPN flaps: MTU + PMTU discovery issue on Tigerbay edge router. Hypothesis: large keepalive packets triggering fragmentation and rekey race. Action: lower MTU on test tunnel to 1400 and redeploy.
2) IAM mapping for KMS calls: service account not in tenant mapping for Tigerbay KMS proxy. Hypothesis: onboarding step missed in runbook.
3) SELinux denials on inference node: packaging script sets file context to default_t incorrectly. Needs repackaging or permissive for test.
4) Quantization artifact mismatch: build script adds 8KB padding for alignment; downstream loader trims differently.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Do not move forward with canary traffic until VPN stability is > 48h and KMS access is green.
- For initial validation we will run synthetic inference load at 25% of expected QPS to validate tail latency and KV cache hit rates.
- Tigerbay will open an internal ticket for edge router vendor to check PMTU behavior; Redwood will provide packet captures.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we need an extra static route for GPU compute nodes to reach storage when NATed? (Evan to validate network paths end-to-end.)
- HSM key rotation window: Tigerbay needs rotation outside business hours; confirm timezone and blackout windows.
- Rollback plan for model artifacts if quantized artifact fails at runtime — do we default to CPU-hosted fallback or use a smaller model?

Action items (owner / due / ticket):
- Lower MTU on staging VPN tunnel to 1400 and monitor for 72h — owner: Rajiv Malhotra — due: 2026-03-15 — ticket: PD-219.
- Provide packet capture and tunnel diagnostics (pcap + ike logs) to Tigerbay network team — owner: Rajiv — due: 2026-03-13 — ticket: INF-5472.
- Update runbook section 2.1 (KMS onboarding) to include tenant mapping checklist and service account mapping steps — owner: Celeste Huang — due: 2026-03-16 — linked: Confluence page.
- Rebuild inference package with SELinux context patch and test on dedicated test node — owner: Alexei Romanov (Tigerbay) + Evan Ortiz — due: 2026-03-17 — note: if blocked, run with permissive and capture AVC logs.
- Add temporary increased tracing sampling to 10% for tail-latency collection for next 7 days — owner: Nora Patel — due: 2026-03-13 — ticket: OBS-88.
- Validate KMS/HSM IAM mapping and run a key unwrap test script end-to-end — owner: Marta Silva (Tigerbay) — due: 2026-03-14 — ticket: PD-225.
- Investigate quantization padding mismatch and produce patched loader or build change — owner: Evan Ortiz + Eng runtime — due: 2026-03-19 — PR: github.com/redwood-inference/tigerbay-deploy/pull/42.
- Draft go/no-go checklist for canary (VPN uptime, KMS green, SELinux test OK, latency <600ms p95) — owner: Nora Patel — due: 2026-03-18.

Notes to self / things to follow up in 1:1 with Rajiv:
- Ask about long-term monitoring retention for VPN rekey events — we might want 90d retention for debug.
- Confirm whether Rajiv can run a packet capture during the next maintenance window (he said yes but needs reminder).

Next sync cadence:
- Standing slot: Tue/Thu quick check (15m) + full sync Friday 45m. Next full sync scheduled 2026-03-13 10:00 PT. Nora to send calendar invite and attach this notes doc.

Misc scratch items (not for customer):
- Consider adding a short-lived fallback tunnel via cloud partner for emergency failover — cost estimate needed.
- Revisit model fallback decision — small model latency profiles vs full model CPU fallback.
- Log where we saw first rekey: 2026-03-11 02:14 UTC on tunnel-2 (capture id: cap-20260311-02).

End of notes.
